title: Stack pack
description: stacks/<name>/pack.yaml: what the worker needs for a language and which static checks run on a patch (design section 5).

detect.description: Files whose presence in the repository root means the project uses the stack.

toolchain.description: Executables the worker image must have to build and test the stack.

tools.description: L1 static checks run by nightshift check after the project's own verify command.

command.description: Run through sh in the worktree; writes SARIF to $NIGHTSHIFT_SARIF, or just fails.

requires.description: Executable the command needs; the tool is skipped, and reported, when the worker lacks it.
